en: Section B interviews.
zh: B节：访谈。

en: In this section, you will hear two interviews.
zh: 在这一节中，你将听到两段访谈。

en: At the end of each interview, five questions will be asked about what was said.
zh: 每段访谈结束后，将就刚才所说的内容提出五个问题。

en: Both the interviews and the questions will be spoken once only.
zh: 访谈和问题都只读一遍。

en: After each question, there will be a ten-second pause.
zh: 每个问题之后会有十秒钟的停顿。

en: During the pause, you should read the four choices of A, B, C, and D and mark the best answer to each question on Answer Sheet 2.
zh: 请利用停顿时间阅读A、B、C、D四个选项，并在答题卡二上标出每题的最佳答案。

en: You have 30 seconds to preview the choices.
zh: 你有三十秒钟预览选项。

en: Now, listen to the first interview.
zh: 现在请听第一段访谈。

en: Questions 1 to 5 are based on the first interview.
zh: 第1至5题根据第一段访谈提问。

en: Today we are having Harriet Sanford on our program to hear about her career in education
zh: 今天，我们邀请到哈丽雅特·桑福德，听她谈谈自己的教育生涯，

en: and her current work supporting public teachers and students through the NEA foundation.
zh: 以及她目前通过NEA基金会支持公立学校教师和学生的工作。

en: Good morning, Harriet.
zh: 早上好，哈丽雅特。

en: Nice to have you here!
zh: 很高兴请到您！

en: Good morning, James.
zh: 早上好，詹姆斯。

en: Harriet, why did you go into education?
zh: 哈丽雅特，您为什么选择从事教育？

en: I began my career about 40 years ago as a public school teacher at an elementary school.
zh: 大约40年前，我在一所公立小学担任教师，由此开启了职业生涯。

en: Although I did not remain in the classroom for many years, my commitment to improving lives and under-served communities for the better never faltered.
zh: 虽然我在课堂上任教的年头不算很多，但我致力于改善人们生活、改善服务不足社区状况的决心，从未动摇。

en: It has been a privilege to work in education philanthropy for the last 12 years.
zh: 过去12年里，能从事教育慈善工作，我深感荣幸。

en: Why have you been involved in education philanthropy, that is, supporting teachers and students through a foundation?
zh: 您为什么投身教育慈善事业，也就是通过基金会来支持教师和学生？

en: Well, to answer your question, I have to start with my parents.
zh: 要回答这个问题，我得先从我的父母说起。

en: Neither my mother nor father completed their education,
zh: 我父母都没有完成学业，

en: but they were adamant that their children take advantage of all of the opportunities that a public education offers both in and out of school time.
zh: 但他们坚持要自己的孩子利用公共教育在课内外提供的一切机会。

en: My parents fully expected their children to pursue higher education and ensured that we could immerse ourselves in our studies, service, sports, and more.
zh: 父母十分期待孩子们接受高等教育，并确保我们能全身心投入学习、服务活动、体育运动等。

en: Now many communities, schools and families are facing insufficient resources, just like what we faced those days.
zh: 现在，许多社区、学校和家庭都面临资源不足的问题，就像我们当年一样。

en: My work and the foundation’s work is to do all we can to ensure that every student has access to a high-quality education and finds his or her own joy in learning.
zh: 我和基金会的工作，就是尽一切所能，确保每个学生都能获得高质量教育，并找到属于自己的学习乐趣。

en: Um, I see. Now, Harriet, can you tell us what the NEA foundation is and what support it gives teachers?
zh: 嗯，我明白了。哈丽雅特，您能介绍一下NEA基金会是什么机构，以及它为教师提供哪些支持吗？

en: OK. The NEA foundation is an independent public charity.
zh: 好的。NEA基金会是一家独立的公共慈善机构。

en: It was created in 1969 by educators for educators, to improve public education for all students.
zh: 它于1969年由教育工作者为教育工作者创立，旨在改善面向所有学生的公共教育。

en: We distribute grants to educators three times each year to fund their creative and innovative classroom projects.
zh: 我们每年向教育工作者发放三次资助金，为他们富有创造性和创新性的课堂项目提供资金。

en: Last year, our grants empowered more than 6,000 educators, reaching more than 186,000 students.
zh: 去年，我们的资助共支持了6000多名教育工作者，惠及18.6万多名学生。

en: That’s wonderful.
zh: 这太好了。

en: We also have annual awards for teaching excellence, honoring the challenging but crucial work that public school educators do every day.
zh: 我们还每年颁发卓越教学奖，表彰公立学校教育工作者每天从事的富有挑战性、又至关重要的工作。

en: Your work is really appreciated.
zh: 你们的工作十分值得肯定。

en: In addition, we have a global learning fellowship.
zh: 此外，我们还有一项全球学习研修项目。

en: Educators can go abroad as part of a year-long professional development program.
zh: 教育工作者可以出国，这是为期一年的专业发展项目的一部分。

en: Participating educators return from their travels with fresh knowledge, skills and perspective needed to teach in the global age.
zh: 参加项目的教育工作者结束行程后，会带回在全球化时代开展教学所需的新知识、技能和视野。

en: And they are better equipped to deliver globally focused curriculum in their home schools and communities.
zh: 他们也更有能力，在本校和社区开设具有全球视野的课程。

en: I have heard that you have a partner called EverFi.
zh: 我听说你们有一家叫EverFi的合作伙伴。

en: How do EverFi and the NEA foundation work together?
zh: EverFi与NEA基金会是怎样合作的呢？

en: Yeah, the NEA foundation and EverFi work together to increase educator and student access to technology and digital learning tools.
zh: NEA基金会和EverFi合作，让更多教育工作者和学生能够使用技术及数字学习工具。

en: We collectively strive to support critical skill areas that will enhance students’ ultimate academic and life success.
zh: 我们共同努力，支持关键技能领域的发展，以增进学生最终在学业和人生中的成功。

en: Could you give us some details about your work?
zh: 您能具体介绍一下这些工作吗？

en: Yeah. OK. The partnership currently supports NEA school districts across the country,
zh: 可以。好的。目前，这项合作为全国各地的NEA学区提供支持，

en: providing free access to EverFi’s digital resources and accompanying professional development.
zh: 让它们免费使用EverFi的数字资源，并获得配套的专业发展培训。

en: A number of school districts have participated.
zh: 已有多个学区参与其中。

en: Our partnership is leading us to work on more programming to develop initiatives in social and emotional learning.
zh: 我们的合作也推动我们策划更多项目，开展社会与情感学习方面的新举措。

en: What encouragement would you give teachers who are working to integrate critical skills’ education into their classrooms?
zh: 对于正在努力把关键技能教育融入课堂的教师，您有什么鼓励的话？

en: My key piece of advice to educators, no matter what or whom they teach, is almost always the same.
zh: 无论教育工作者教什么、教谁，我给他们的核心建议几乎都是一样的。

en: Excellence is what you are after.
zh: 你们要追求的是卓越。

en: And you are not going to let anything, or anyone stand between your students and excellence.
zh: 不要让任何事或任何人，阻挡学生走向卓越。

en: Be gentle, kind and caring with your students, but be fierce about their education.
zh: 对待学生，要温柔、友善、关爱；但对于他们的教育，要坚定执着。

en: OK, thank you very much, Harriet, for talking to us about your work.
zh: 非常感谢您，哈丽雅特，谢谢您向我们介绍自己的工作。

en: Pleasure!
zh: 很荣幸！

en: This is the end of the first interview.
zh: 第一段访谈到此结束。

en: Questions one to five are based on what you have just heard.
zh: 第1至5题根据你刚才听到的内容提问。

en: Question 1. Why does the woman go into education?
zh: 这位女士为什么从事教育工作？

en: Question 2. What is her parents’ attitude towards their children’s education?
zh: 她父母对孩子的教育持什么态度？

en: Question 3. What does the NEA foundation do to improve public education?
zh: NEA基金会为改善公共教育做了什么？

en: Question 4. What do both EverFi and the NEA foundation plan to do in the future?
zh: EverFi和NEA基金会未来共同计划做什么？

en: Question 5. According to the woman, what quality should be pursued by a teacher?
zh: 根据这位女士的说法，教师应该追求什么品质？
